title: Equidistribution of CM points and RM curves
summary: In 1988, William Duke showed that CM points of fundamental discriminant $D$ are equidistributed in the complex upper half-plane $\mathcal H$ as $D \to -\infty$. He also showed a similar result for RM curves (a positive discriminant analog of CM points). In this paper, we investigate analogous problems concerning the distribution of CM points and RM curves along fixed geodesics in $\mathcal H$, and around fixed points in $\mathcal H$.
